4. Process Model Generation - System creates a visual process model from extracted information. - Process includes tasks, decisions, flows, and subprocesses. - Each model element is linked to its source document text.
5. Model Refinement - User reviews and edits the generated process model. - User defines task types, conditions, and subprocess relationships. - System maintains traceability between model elements and document fragments.
6. Subprocess Linking - Subprocesses reference separate process models. - User can navigate between parent and child models. - Hierarchical model relationships are preserved.
7. Model Management - Multiple models are stored and listed. - User switches between models and views previews. - Models can be updated or reused.
8. Output - Finalized process models are exported. -
